headline_en: Sep 18 briefing · 5 new · loss $3.6M · enforcement $25K · 3 follow-ups
briefing_ko:
- **[Nostra](https://x.com/nostrafinance/status/2100577538053493076?s=46&t=DLwbX9Nw4QECiyZQ0av-fg)** · Starknet · 해킹 · **$3.5M** · 9.17 — NSTR 오라클 가격을 인위적으로 올려 과다 담보를 만들고 대출 실행
- **[Christopher Michael Cadman](https://www.justice.gov/usao-cdca/pr/former-la-county-sheriffs-deputy-sentenced-nearly-2-years-prison-violating-civil)** · 수사·기소 · **$25K** · 9.14 — 공권력 남용·세금 누락 혐의로 21개월 징역형 선고 및 배상 명령
- **소액·미상 3건** — [Nimiq](https://x.com/DefimonAlerts/status/2100868892742602793) $50K, [BitBank](https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/ofac-sanctions-bitbank-expanding-action-against-babak-zanjanis-digital-asset-network) hundreds of millions of dollars worth of Bitcoin, [Decent](https://www.tokenpost.kr/news/blockchain/410350) 금액 미상
- **후속 3건** — [Flamincome](https://defillama.com/hacks) (첫 보도 9.17), [RsETHSafeModule](https://github.com/SunWeb3Sec/DeFiHackLabs/blob/main/src/test/2026-09/RsETHSafeModule_exp.sol) (첫 보도 9.15), [Chainflip](https://www.tokenpost.kr/news/blockchain/409959) (첫 보도 9.15)
- **시사점** — 제재 회피와 오라클 조작이 가상자산에서 대규모 자금 탈취로 계속 발생한다.
briefing_en:

- **[Christopher Michael Cadman](https://www.justice.gov/usao-cdca/pr/former-la-county-sheriffs-deputy-sentenced-nearly-2-years-prison-violating-civil)** · Enforcement · **$25K** · Sep 14 — Convicted of abuse of authority and tax evasion, sentenced…
- **Smaller / unknown (3)** — [Nimiq](https://x.com/DefimonAlerts/status/2100868892742602793) $50K, [BitBank](https://www.trmlabs.com/resources/blog/ofac-sanctions-bitbank-expanding-action-against-babak-zanjanis-digital-asset-network) hundreds of millions of dollars worth of Bitcoin, [Decent](https://www.tokenpost.kr/news/blockchain/410350) amount n/a
- **Follow-ups (3)** — [Flamincome](https://defillama.com/hacks) (first 9.17), [RsETHSafeModule](https://github.com/SunWeb3Sec/DeFiHackLabs/blob/main/src/test/2026-09/RsETHSafeModule_exp.sol) (first 9.15), [Chainflip](https://www.tokenpost.kr/news/blockchain/409959) (first 9.15)
- **Takeaway** — Sanctions evasion and oracle manipulation remain prevalent tactics for large-scale crypto fund theft today.
